summary: Executed focused backend migration regression for questionnaire approval flow and unified ESG response storage. 36/37 tests passed; one critical functional mismatch remains in questionnaire queue source isolation.

critical.issue: Queue includes non-questionnaire pending records from approval_requests (e.g., emission_record) instead of only pending canonical questionnaire records from organization_esg_responses.

action_items: Restrict ApprovalWorkflowService.get_questionnaire_approval_queue() to canonical questionnaire source only (organization_esg_responses with approval_status=pending_approval) and remove/guard PART 2 + PART 3 non-questionnaire appends for this endpoint.
Optionally update stale comments in esg_assignments/service.py and esg_tracking/service.py that still mention esg_responses as source-of-truth, to avoid migration confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: approval_workflow/service.py:get_questionnaire_approval_queue currently aggregates from three sources (canonical responses + approval_requests + pending_emission_records), violating strict questionnaire-only queue requirement.
Cross-organization guard in legacy questionnaire approve endpoint is functioning (response lookup scoped by approver organization).
Legacy esg_responses Mongo collection remained absent before and after tested flows; migration persistence checks passed.
seed_data_creation: Seeded temporary TEST_ITER31_* question configs, canonical responses, and one emission approval_request for isolation; cleaned up in pytest fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Latest run command: pytest test_questionnaire_migration_iter31.py test_questionnaire_approval_iter123.py test_unified_collection_iter128.py test_gri_approval_flow.py test_internal_ai_brsr_regressions.py test_internal_ai_iter159_regression_scope_history.py -v --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results_iter31_migration.xml. Only failing case is questionnaire queue source pollution by seeded emission approval_request.
rca of the issue: Repro: seed one pending organization_esg_responses doc and one pending approval_requests emission_record in same org; call GET /api/approval-workflows/questionnaire/queue as admin. Observed emission request id returned in items. Root cause: ApprovalWorkflowService.get_questionnaire_approval_queue() appends PART 2 approval_requests (entity_type emission_record/esg_record) and PART 3 pending_emission_records after querying canonical questionnaire responses. Mitigation: split queue responsibilities by endpoint (questionnaire endpoint should return only canonical questionnaire approvals) or add explicit source filter guard before appending non-questionnaire items.
